description: Transcribe a public video (up to 2 hours) and propose up to 3 shareable moments (5 on Pro) of 10–90 s, optionally focused on `looking`. Returns a moments_id while processing: call find_moments again with moments_id to check. Pass any returned moment’s start and end seconds to edit_video (up to 15 s on Free, 90 s on Pro). Cached for 30 days.

item.description: 1-based item from get_video_info; a photo-only post can offer a slideshow after its last photo.

looking.description: Optional topic to focus on, e.g. “where they discuss pricing”.

url.description: Link to a public post or video (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick).

name: find_moments
title: Find clip-worthy moments in a video
